title: Food Aid Program Cuts Help for Families in Gaza
summary:
The World Food Programme, or WFP, is a United Nations agency that gives food to people in need. It says it must "drastically reduce lifesaving assistance" in Gaza because it does not have enough money.

The number of people the WFP helps there will drop by about a third, from 1.6 million to 1.1 million. Hot meals served each day by community kitchens will fall from 250,000 to 150,000. Families in some hard-to-reach areas will get a meal every other day instead of every day. The number of people receiving bags of flour and ration boxes each month will fall from 1.1 million to 600,000.

The WFP's Palestine director, Shaun Hughes, said the cuts are about money, "not because the needs are coming down, or because we don't have access - we do." The agency received less than half as much funding for its Palestinian work in 2026 as in earlier years. It says it urgently needs $450 million to keep its most important work going for the next six months.

Nearly all of Gaza's 2.1 million people have been forced from their homes, and two-thirds depend on food aid. A ceasefire between Hamas and Israel was agreed a year ago, but violence has continued and living conditions remain very hard. Food markets have supplies, but more than 80% of people have no jobs, so few can afford to buy food.

Parents in Gaza worry about the change. Mervat al-Satari, a mother of five living in a camp, asked, "How will we provide for the little ones?" Sawsan Bahloul, a mother of three, said kitchen portions of pasta or lentils were already too small for her family.

The cuts come as winter approaches.
why_it_matters: Aid groups depend on donations from governments, and when money runs short, families who rely on that help may not get enough to eat. The story shows how funding decisions far away affect children's daily meals.

keywords.explanation: An agency is an organization that does a specific job, often for a government or a group like the United Nations.
Lifesaving assistance is help, such as food, that people need to survive.
A ration is a fixed amount of food or supplies given to each person or family.
A ceasefire is an agreement to stop fighting.
Funding is money given to pay for a program or project.

background_read: Gaza is a small Palestinian territory along the Mediterranean Sea, and after years of conflict most of its people have been forced from their homes.
The World Food Programme is the United Nations agency that delivers food in emergencies, and it depends on money donated by governments and others.
When donations fall, the agency has to decide how to share less food among many people, which can mean smaller or less frequent meals.
A ceasefire between Hamas and Israel was agreed, but living conditions remain very hard, so many families still depend on aid.
